name: Attenuated Maximum-Intensity Projection
definition: A CPU-emulated rendering technique that casts rays through a volume, normalizing samples to a contrast window, weighting them by an exponential falloff based on accumulated intensity in front, and keeping the running maximum. This dims deeper/weaker samples so only strong peaks survive, preventing background haze from bleeding over everything.
summary: Attenuated Maximum-Intensity Projection is a volume rendering technique that suppresses background noise by weighting samples with an exponential falloff based on accumulated intensity, unlike standard MIP which selects the highest value regardless of depth.
